alternativeSelection.assessment: Two alternatives are included. The closest match is retained. A second, evidence-backed climate and sustainability governance route differs by seven courses / 52.5 EC. notes.text: The Erasmus programme integrates public administration, policy, law, sociology, economics, management, methods, an internship and a bachelor project. UCR can combine politics, sociology, law, economics, organisation and leadership, research methods, and—where relevant—environmental governance, but does not offer a dedicated Public Administration curriculum with the same structured internship and bachelor-project sequence.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Re-audited under the substantial-curricular-correspondence rule. No available UCR row provides a sufficiently substantial counterpart without overstating partial or adjacent overlap.
Sociology I is most directly comparable to UCR Introduction to Sociology; this row was selected by semantic review after fixing the canonical UCR rows.

Staats- en Bestuursrecht and UCR Comparative Constitutional Law have substantial curricular correspondence in public/constitutional legal structures, including administrative-law territory; the overlap is sufficient for shared-row comparison even though the courses are not equivalent.

Organisation & Management and UCR Psychology of Organizations & Leadership both address the functioning and management of organisations. Their framing differs, but the substantive organisational domain is sufficiently shared for row alignment.
Designing Social Research is most directly comparable to UCR Research Methods & Statistics; this row was selected by semantic review after fixing the canonical UCR rows.

Bestuurskunde Vaardigheden develops academic and professional skills, including scientific reading, literature-study writing and research presentation. UCR Personal & Professional Development likewise develops core academic and professional skills through source analysis, academic writing, presentation, reflection and independent learning; the educational function substantially corresponds.

Network Governance and UCR Governance of Sustainability both center governance as multi-actor collective decision-making involving public and non-public actors around public problems. UCR applies the governance framework to sustainability, but the primary governance content substantially corresponds.
